description: The snapshot-worktree browser extension is a Chrome Manifest V3 application designed to capture screen areas, perform OCR and QR decoding, and provide AI-driven translations. The system architecture separates privileged background orchestration from unprivileged content script UI interactions, utilizing a specialized automation layer to interface with web-based AI services like ChatGPT.

components.name: User Interface & Interaction Layer
components.description: Manages the visual overlay on web pages for area selection and the configuration interfaces. It handles user input events, manages the Snap selection box, and displays the final results (OCR text or translations) to the user.

components.name: Content Script Overlay & Selection Engine
components.description: Operates within the DOM of the active web page to provide a visual selection tool. It manages the lifecycle of the 'Snap' box, captures mouse coordinates for area selection, and injects a custom UI container to display OCR results and translation actions directly over the page content.

components.name: Extension Management Interfaces (Options & Popup)
components.description: Provides the administrative and entry-point UI for the extension. The Popup serves as the primary trigger for the selection engine, while the Options page manages persistent state, including API configurations (OpenAI/LocalLLM), authentication status, and user preferences stored in chrome.storage.

components_relations.relation: Triggers the initialization of the selection overlay via chrome.tabs.sendMessage

components.name: Orchestration & API Gateway
components.description: The central hub of the extension (Background Service Worker). It coordinates communication between the UI, the processing engines, and external AI services. It manages state, handles cross-origin API requests to OpenAI, and routes tasks based on user configuration.

components.name: Message Router & Orchestrator
components.description: The primary entry point for all extension events. It manages the lifecycle of the background worker, listens for cross-component messages via the Chrome Runtime, and dispatches tasks to specialized logic handlers based on the action type.

components.name: AI Gateway & Translation Engine
components.description: A unified interface for AI processing that combines business logic for translation with the technical implementation of API communication. It prepares prompts based on user settings, manages cross-origin fetch requests to OpenAI or local providers, and parses structured responses for the UI.

components.name: Web Automation Controller
components.description: Manages complex interactions with external AI web interfaces (like ChatGPT). It coordinates the execution of automation scripts that simulate user actions, such as text input and button clicks, while monitoring the page state to ensure synchronization with the AI's response lifecycle.

components_relations.relation: Dispatches validated translation and OCR requests for processing.
Triggers hands-free automation sequences when the user selects "Automate" modes.
Provides processed text or context to be injected into the target AI web interface.

components.name: Vision Processing Engine
components.description: A heavy-duty client-side processing suite that utilizes WebAssembly (Tesseract) for Optical Character Recognition and specialized logic for QR code decoding. It transforms raw image data into structured text or URI data.

components.name: Tesseract WASM Runtime & VFS
components.description: The low-level execution environment for OCR. It manages the Emscripten-based WebAssembly lifecycle, including memory allocation and a Virtual File System (VFS) used to load language training data (.traineddata) and temporary image buffers.

components.name: OCR API & Layout Analyzer
components.description: The high-level interface for text recognition. It utilizes the WASM runtime to initialize the TessBaseAPI, process images, and perform layout analysis to extract structured text, orientation, and confidence metrics.

components.name: QR Detection & Geometry Engine
components.description: Responsible for the computer vision aspect of QR code processing. It locates finder patterns, calculates perspective transforms via bit matrices, and extracts the raw bitstream from the image.

components.name: QR Decoder & Error Correction
components.description: Handles the logical decoding of the QR bitstream. It applies Reed-Solomon error correction to recover data from noisy or damaged codes and parses the final URI or text payload.

components_relations.relation: invokes the WASM exports and manages language data files within the virtual filesystem
passes the extracted bit matrix and perspective-corrected data for error recovery and final bitstream parsing
provides feedback on decoding success to trigger alternative localization attempts if error correction fails

components.name: Web Automation Bridge
components.description: A specialized component that automates the ChatGPT web interface. It acts as an alternative to direct API calls, simulating user interaction to input text and extract AI-generated translations directly from the browser DOM.
